note: Independent, YC W19-backed dev-tools startup founded 2018 by Solomon Hykes (Docker co-founder) with Sam Alba and Andrea Luzzardi. Core Dagger Engine is open source; commercial layer is 'Dagger Cloud' (Individual/Team/Enterprise), currently in early access with usage-based observability pricing, not the hosted-compute product this card's inventory targets. Confirmed hint: the YC directory listing for 'Dagger' (W19, Active, San Francisco) links to https://dagger.io, the same domain as this provider.
